newsitem.title: UK: BTR RISES AS INVESTORS EYE UPSIDE.
newsitem.headline: BTR RISES AS INVESTORS EYE UPSIDE.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc rose on Thursday to levels not seen since the start of July as investors saw room for a move to the upside, analysts said.
The company had missed out on the recent rebound of 10-15 percent in the engineering sector, one said.
"The price has been left behind," said Andrew Mitchell, analyst at Merrill Lynch.
By 1009 GMT the shares were trading up 7p at 207-1/2p.
A profit warning on May 8 about the adverse affect of the strength of sterling on the company's results sent the shares into freefall.
They fell from a May high of 279p to about 180p in June, a drop of over 30 percent. Since then the shares have hovered in the 185-205p range.
